body:
Parent: #22 (Evidence & Data Trust).

## Traceability and dependencies
Requirements: FR-04, FR-07 (defined in parent epic breakdown).
Depends on: #34, #35

## Outcome
Saved product observations retain retrievable evidence across restarts, and retention cannot silently leave apparently supported facts pointing to deleted records.

## Scope and technical plan
- Extend self-hosted SQLite snapshot persistence with versioned evidence storage and retrieval by ID; document ownership, ID scope, deduplication and transactions.
- Atomically persist snapshots, observations, captured payloads and references; preserve original source timestamps and Decimal/UTC representations.
- Migrate existing databases conservatively and idempotently: existing identity/history remain intact, missing historical evidence is explicitly unsupported, and observed times are not invented from migration time.
- Define configurable retention limits and explicit pruning. Protect retained references or mark them expired/unavailable with a reason; distinguish missing, expired and unsupported retrieval outcomes. Document default retention and bounded payload sizes.

## Acceptance scenarios
- Given a snapshot with product and variant observations, when reopened in a new connection, then evidence IDs retrieve the same source fragments and metadata.
- Given a write failure, then no partial snapshot with falsely retrievable evidence remains.
- Given a legacy database and two migration runs, then identities/history are stable and historical unsupported status is unchanged.
- Given retention pruning with shared references, then retained observations either resolve valid evidence or explicitly expose expiration; no silent dangling support claims.

## Validation and task handoff
Temporary SQLite restart, rollback, migration and retention fixtures, plus snapshot identity/completeness regressions. Record schema/API and operating limits in shared planning artifacts.

## Spec Kit workflow
Use one shared feature directory, `specs/002-evidence-data-trust/`. Specify user outcomes and Given/When/Then scenarios in `spec.md`; record architecture, compatibility and resolved questions in `plan.md`; maintain dependency-ordered, requirement-linked work in `tasks.md`. Update the relevant artifacts before implementation and verify spec/plan/tasks consistency before closing this ticket. These are required implementation deliverables, not artifacts already generated by an installed Spec Kit workflow.

## Boundaries and definition of done
Evidence-backed reporting only; no catalog mutations, MCP, webhooks, or other epic work. Preserve MIT licensing and self-hostability. Prefer deterministic, offline fixtures; no model launch or broad live crawl is required. Document public APIs and limitations, and run meaningful affected compatibility checks. Do not equate extraction quality, rule/model scores, and validated confidence.
title: [Epic 2] Persist retrievable evidence with explicit retention and migration
